text:
anya: Quick design check: proposing a 'peek panel' on the right of the invite drawer that updates when you hover or focus a role in the roles grid. Aim: avoid extra clicks while keeping the grid compact. Figma: https://figma.redwood/peek-panel :link

jules: Peek panel sounds useful for desktop. For mobile, we should collapse it into an inline expander or bottom sheet. Also suggest a density switch (Compact / Regular) persisted per user.

rui: Accessibility checklist: rows must be keyboard navigable with Arrow keys; focused row should update the peek panel and we should announce via aria-live: "Role preview: Viewer. Can read projects and audit logs." Use aria-selected on rows and aria-controls linking to the preview region.

sarah: Copy: preview header: "Viewer — permissions". Teaser line in grid: "Viewer — read only". SSO note: annotate roles that require SSO with a small lock and tooltip: "SSO required to assign". For the SSO disable confirm, legal wants explicit wording: "Disabling SSO enforcement may allow users to sign in without your IdP. To confirm, type your org name." CTA: "Disable enforcement"

ken: Telemetry we need: `invite.peek_open`, `invite.role_focus`, `invite.density_changed`, `invite.sso_confirmed`. Track device width and whether peek was used before invite sent.

matt: Implementation: preserve role selection when navigating to Audit Logs via URL param like `?role=viewer&src=invite`. Show a small banner in Audit Logs: "Filtered by: Viewer (from Invite)" with a clear target to remove. Keyboard users should clear with Esc when the banner is focused.

rui: Accessibility nit: ensure truncated role names include aria-label with full role + short permission summary. Focus styles must be visible in high-contrast themes. For modals require focus trap and a visible cancel button.

ux-bot: assets: uploaded `invite/peek-panel/v1` + `ssoconfirm/typed` frames to Figma. :white_check_mark:

anya: Next steps: Rui to write ARIA + keyboard spec (EOD Thu); Matt to update Figma with mobile fallback and density toggle (Wed); Sarah to finalize SSO modal copy for legal (Thu); Ken to add telemetry events (this sprint).

jules: I'll run a small 5-person usability test on Friday focusing on discoverability of the peek panel.

anya: Great. Thanks all — we'll revisit after the mocks and one accessibility review. :sparkles:
